text: Figure 7.4: Example architecture of the host interacting with a hardware-protected se- cure environment (HPSE) to retrieve the integrity status. [SWS_Crypto_00302] Integrity check failed Upstream requirements: RS_Ids_00810 ⌈If the Crypto Driver is informed by the HPSE that a SW component integrity check failed, it shall raise the SEv SEV_EXEC_SW_COMPONENT_INTEGRITY_CHECK_FAILED.⌋ [SWS_Crypto_00303] Security event context data definition: SEV_EXEC_SW_ COMPONENT_INTEGRITY_CHECK_FAILED Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: RS_Ids_00810 ⌈ SEV Name SEV_EXEC_SW_COMPONENT_INTEGRITY_CHECK_FAILED ID 99 Description The integrity check of a SW component has failed. Context Data Version 1 Context Data Data Type Allowed Values SWComponent uint16 VerificationMode uint8 RECOVERY (0x00) MEASURED_BOOT (0x01) RUNTIME_PERIODIC (0x02) STRICT (0x03) ⌋ The SEV_EXEC_SW_COMPONENT_INTEGRITY_CHECK_FAILED security event contains the following context data: • SW Component: Defines for which SW component the integrity verification failed. The actual value is highly project specific and cannot be standardized in AU- TOSAR
